scope: local native synthetic data and SIGKILL only; no power-cut test, rollback protection, real trust, network or release
qualificationNote: Synthetic in-memory map matching head->announce shape; no wire parser or actual peer transport. External decoder must enforce message bounds and reject duplicate keys, and the caller must supply independent trusted checkpoint and signer. No operational fleet synchronization or rollback protection is qualified.
developmentNote: Earlier probes returned SIGTRAP when missing fields reached document-get on non-map; map guards were added and final gate passed. Initial EDN reader approach was discarded.
